feature: Improve the software/agent factory: put a work time limiter on every agent and sub agent (under 5 minutes). If an agent exceeds that time, stop it, identify why it took long, note the issue, and collect it into a pending issue for this session. Resume the stopped process to continue the factory flow. The saved pending improvement may start only once the session that created it is done. Use the session's identified issues to improve the factory recursively (agents, tools, skills). Add a benchmark to score and test before/after.

commands.build: for h in claude-code opencode codex copilot zcode; do python3 tools/render.py "$h" || exit; done
commands.test: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools && bash -n install.sh && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- dist/)"

timeline.summary: Brainstorm round 1: scope, enforcement, budget, trigger, benchmark, commands
Brainstorm round 2: issue triggers, non-resumable roles, backlog location, benchmark driver
Grill round 1: resume cap, unit boundaries, orchestrator scope, bench stop point, bench pass

decisions.question: Q1
decisions.answer: B: this run = time budget + issue log + gated backlog + benchmark core; recursive improver deferred to follow-up run

decisions.question: Q2
decisions.answer: A: cooperative deadline in role inputs, role returns partial with slow-reason; orchestrator post-hoc ledger check; fresh spawn resumes

decisions.question: Q3
decisions.answer: B: default 5m, per-role override in config.json

decisions.question: Q4
decisions.answer: A: overrunning role self-reports cause; orchestrator attaches ledger facts

decisions.question: Q5
decisions.answer: A: manual /factory improve; CLI refuses while source run not pr-open/aborted

decisions.question: Q6
decisions.answer: A: replay fixture feature(s), score wall time, overruns, spawns, token estimates, review pass; scorer shared with recorded-state reading

decisions.question: Q7
decisions.answer: B: overruns + agent failures/retries + halts + red verify, each tagged kind

decisions.question: Q8
decisions.answer: A: hard stop + resume only for file-writing roles (spec-builder, code-build, fixer); reviewers/judge soft limit, record issue, finish

decisions.question: Q9
decisions.answer: A: issues in run state.json via writer + backlog file FACTORY_HOME/improvements/<run>.json written at run end

decisions.question: Q10
decisions.answer: A: pre-baked fixture run from worktree stage, fast, auto-approve, headless harness CLI, scorer reads state.json; manual path documented as fallback

decisions.question: G1
decisions.answer: A: halt after 3 consecutive partial spawns with no new commit; unlimited while progress committed

decisions.question: G2
decisions.answer: A: finish current unit then stop; overshoot recorded in issue detail

decisions.question: G3
decisions.answer: A: budget enforced on spawned roles only; orchestrator verify over budget recorded as overrun issue role orchestrator, never stopped

decisions.question: G4
decisions.answer: A: bench runs with --stop-at approver, scored there; no auto-approve flag, no PR

decisions.question: G5
decisions.answer: B: reached approver + last verify green + no unresolved blocking findings + fixture acceptance test passes
